title: Tenant-configurable intake lanes with weighted SLA mapping for hosted streaming toolcalls
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers require deterministic onboarding and SLA-aware prioritization for multi-turn chat requests that invoke streaming tool/function calls and emit structured outputs. They want fine-grained control per-tenant over which requests are allowed into higher-priority lanes, how SLA tiers translate into routing and fallback policies, and visibility into how scores are computed.

Scope: Design the intake lane configuration model (tenant-scoped) and the weighted SLA mapping engine. Work includes: schema for lane rules, weighting factors (sla_score, customer_commitment, cost_sensitivity, tool_complexity), console UI for configuring lanes, API for evaluating request priority at ingress, integration with routing policies (canary/backfill/fallback), telemetry and dashboards, and a short eval harness for common enterprise prompt patterns. This is a product-first spec; engineering will scope infra changes after design review.
acceptance_criteria: A tenant-level intake UI mockup exists that allows creation/editing of named lanes with rule sets and weight sliders
An intake rule schema is documented (JSON) with examples for: SLA tier mapping, allowed toolsets, sequence-length thresholds, and deny/allow lists
A priority score formula is defined and validated on a sample set of 200 enterprise requests showing expected ranking across tiers
API contract for /v1/intake/evaluate is specified (inputs: tenant_id, request_metadata, tools_used) and a mock response example provided
Routing policy mapping table created that ties score bands to runtime actions (route to dedicated, host pool, fallback model, or queue) and includes cost/latency estimates
Telemetry plan: metrics for intake_rate, lane_distribution, score_histogram, routed_backend, and SLA-miss events specified and dashboard wireframe sketched
Security review checklist completed for tenant-scoped policies and role-based access for lane configuration

decisions: Use weighted linear combination for score: score = w1*sla_score + w2*customer_commitment + w3*(1/cost_estimate) + w4*tool_complexity_penalty. Allow tenants to select presets that set the weights.
Evaluation will run synchronously in the ingress path but gated behind a feature flag with a fast-path fallback to existing default routing to avoid latency regressions.
Tenant lane configs are stored in the private control plane and editable via Console; editing requires RBAC role 'lane_admin' and changes are audit-logged.
We will not permit tenant policies to bypass global safety or compliance filters; deny/allow lists are subject to validation by the policy service.
